execution_policy.selection_rule: Execute exactly one eligible highest-priority READY atomic leaf, or one task explicitly marked acceptance_batch=true, per scheduled run; then STOP.
execution_policy.ssot_rule: Read current origin/main, LASTSTANDINGPOINT.md, this graph, relevant receipts, and all active engineering leases before selection.
execution_policy.lease_rule: Before any remote repository mutation, acquire both income-os.repo-write and factory-asset.<task_id> through bin/die_engineering_lease.py using the shared Architect MCP coordination root D:\mcp-architect\workspace\.engineering-leases; release both in finally. BUSY, corrupt, or token-mismatch states fail closed.
execution_policy.dirty_tree_rule: Do not mutate, reset, stash, clean, or repurpose the live dirty C:\DIE or D:\OAUTH trees.
execution_policy.linux_rule: Use a fresh Linux-native isolated worktree/check-out based on current origin/main for Linux-target implementation and tests; never build in or mutate the live /srv/die checkout.
execution_policy.production_protection_rule: The live Linux Production Organism and die-production-cycle-v1 at 0 */3 * * * are observation-only for this program: no deploy, restart, stop, reconfiguration, profile/credential/queue/database write, cron mutation, active-artifact mutation, or cutover.
execution_policy.windows_rule: D:\OAUTH provider work is Founder-directed and interactive on Windows; preserve the working text/chat-completion path, run before/after regression, and never let the autonomous Linux schedule select Windows tasks.
execution_policy.repair_rule: On failure create at most one minimal repair child <task_id>-R<n>; do not restart the roadmap unless an ADR assumption is falsified.
prohibited: counting packaging derivatives as distinct assets

lease_protocol.stale_recovery: Expired records may be reclaimed only by the canonical helper while holding the kernel guard; corrupt state fails closed.

CANON_GOVERNED.activation_gate: FA-000 completed by governed publication. Normal lane selection follows canonical dependencies and execution-lane rules.

LINUX_HOURLY_BUILD.selection: Select exactly one READY task whose execution_lane is LINUX_HOURLY_BUILD or omitted/defaulted to LINUX_HOURLY_BUILD; execute in a fresh isolated worktree; validate; update receipt/graph/LASTSTANDINGPOINT; then STOP.
LINUX_HOURLY_BUILD.schedule_offset_rule: Active at minute 35 UTC, separated from the Chapter #4 hourly runner near minute 00 and the production cycle at minute 00 every three hours.
LINUX_HOURLY_BUILD.scheduled_prompt_contract: Use current origin/main as SSOT. If revision 1.1-dual-lane is not canonical, execute only FA-000 from the Founder-approved staged pack and STOP. After canonization, read LASTSTANDINGPOINT, Factory task graph, relevant ADR/PRD/receipts and active leases; select exactly one highest-priority READY Linux leaf. If Architect MCP, repository access, required evidence, or both leases are unavailable, make no mutation and report the stop condition. Work only in a fresh isolated Linux worktree. Never mutate /srv/die, its cron, runtime, profiles, credentials, queues, databases or active artifacts. Do not select FA-W* tasks or make provider/account/marketplace actions. Build, test and verify; publish only green governed changes; update the receipt, graph and LASTSTANDINGPOINT; then STOP.
LINUX_HOURLY_BUILD.lease_acquisition: Use bin/die_engineering_lease.py acquire-pair with the canonical coordination root before the first remote repository mutation; release-pair in finally. The existence of unfinished WINDOWS_OAUTH_LAB work is not lease contention.

WINDOWS_OAUTH_LAB.selection: Execute only explicitly selected FA-W* or OAUTH security/autopsy task on D:\OAUTH; one provider proof at a time; run text/chat regression before and after.

coordination.rule: Factory Asset work must not silently preempt Chapter #4 work. Activation requires an explicit Factory schedule scope and shared global repo-write lease.
